definitions.full: H3770. kares [ כָּרֵשׂ ] noun [masculine] belly (Late Hebrew כֶּרֶס id. ; Aramaic כַּרְסָא id. ; Mandean כארסא כראס, , uterus , Nö M 151, 157 ; Arabic Ethiopic wrinkled or folded stomach of cud-chewing animals; compare Lag BN 20, 44 ; Assyrian karšu , body , belly ); — only suffix כְּרֵשׂוֺ Jer 51:34 of Nebuchadrezzar under figure of sea-monster.
